function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More Info | |-------|------------|------------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • General limit: 55 mph on rural roads, 45 mph on urban roads.
• 70 mph on interstate highways (except where posted otherwise).
• 65 mph on freeways in urban areas. | Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT) – Speed Limit Regulations | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All occupants must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held phone use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher is illegal.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians at crosswalks.
• Stop at stop signs and red lights.
• “Right‑of‑way” rules for merging, turning, and highway exits. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Vehicles must stop when a school bus is loading/unloading children.
• Stop in both directions unless the bus is traveling on a one‑way street. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals.
• Do not cut off other drivers.
• Keep a safe following distance. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk, fire hydrant, or stop sign.
• Parking in handicap spaces requires a valid permit. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Vehicle Registration & Inspection** | • Annual vehicle inspection required in most counties.
• Registration renewal is due annually. | Texas Department of Motor Vehicles (TxDMV) | | **Toll Roads & Bridges** | • Texas has several toll roads (e.g., Sam Houston Tollway).
• Electronic toll collection (TxTag) is mandatory on many. | TxDOT Toll Roads | | **Emergency Vehicle Rules** | • Drivers must pull over to the right and stop when an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaches. | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Traffic School** | • First‑time offenders may attend traffic school to avoid points on their license. | TxDMV Traffic School Program | ### How to Stay Updated - **TxDOT Website** – Official rules, speed limits, and road conditions. - **TxDMV** – Licensing, registration, and inspection requirements. - **Texas Transportation Code** – Full legal text (available online). Feel free to ask if you need details on a specific law or how to handle a particular driving scenario!
